identificationModule.briefTitle: Cabozantinib and Pembrolizumab in Metastatic Pancreas
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase II Clinical Trial Evaluating Cabozantinib and Pembrolizumab in Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate cabozantinib and pembrolizumab for the treatment of metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

interventions.name: Cabozantinib
interventions.description: Cabozantinib (XL184) is a potent inhibitor of multiple receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs) known to play important roles in tumor cell proliferation and/or tumor neovascularization.

interventions.name: Pembrolizumab
interventions.description: Pembrolizumab is a potent humanized immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) monoclonal antibody (mAb) with high specificity of binding to the programmed cell death 1 (PD-1) receptor, thus inhibiting its interaction with programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) and programmed cell death ligand 2 (PD-L2).

primaryOutcomes.description: Progress-free survival in participants, defined as the time from the start of treatment until the first documentation of disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever comes first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Response to Therapy
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of participants with overall response to therapy via imaging; Overall Response Rate (%) = (Number of patients achieving Complete responses + Number of patients achieving partial responses / Total Number of patients) × 100

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Complete Response
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of participants with a complete response to therapy

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Partial Response
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of participants with a partial response to therapy

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
* Evidence of progression or intolerance to previous standard of care pancreatic cancer systemic or locoregional therapies
* Patients must have adequate organ function

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chemotherapy or other locoregional anti-tumoral therapies performed within 28 days of study treatment initiation
* Received palliative radiation therapy within 2 weeks or any other radiation therapy within 4 weeks of start of study intervention
* Has received prior systemic anti-cancer therapy including investigational agents within 4 weeks prior to allocation
* Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency (autoimmune disease) or is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy
* Clinically significant cardiovascular disease
* Uncontrolled hypertension
* Inability to swallow tablets
